profile.name: Sheikh Yeasin Ahsanullah Al-Galib
profile.title: Junior Software Engineer • Full-Stack & Applied AI
profile.bio: Software engineer with hands-on experience building web applications, RESTful APIs, and AI-powered systems using Python, React, React Native, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and Docker. Currently building Intelleeo AI Studio full-time and continuing as technical co-founder of AIELTS, an AI-driven IELTS evaluation platform funded by the World Bank and Bangladesh ICT Ministry. Open to full-time junior software engineering roles.

experience.description: Full-time technical lead building full-stack AI applications and cross-platform mobile/web solutions, started immediately after leaving PieBD.
highlights: Cut external LLM inference costs 25%, measured by monthly API billing, by building a token-caching layer and async task queues across the FastAPI backend.
Raised microservice throughput 35%, measured by load-testing requests/sec, by rearchitecting core services into modular FastAPI endpoints.

experience.description: Co-founded and led technical development part-time alongside full-time engineering work at PieBD (Aug 2024–Oct 2025); continuing as technical co-founder in a reduced capacity while building Intelleeo AI Studio full-time.
highlights: Won 1st place at the UIHP national startup challenge and secured World Bank / ICT Ministry grant funding, measured by judged competition outcome, by building a working AI-based IELTS evaluator.
Built real-time speaking-and-writing evaluation algorithms scored against IELTS rubrics, using Python, NLP, and LLM APIs.

experience.description: Full-time engineering role building production web applications and RESTful APIs for client solutions.
highlights: Maintained 99.9% production uptime, measured by server monitoring and incident logs, by managing Linux infrastructure (Caddy, systemd, automated SSL, scheduled backups).
Built and maintained RESTful APIs in Python supporting core client workflows.

projects.title: Casheeo — Offline-First Cross-Platform App
projects.description: Cross-platform mobile and web app built with React Native (Expo) and NativeWind, using Supabase as the backend.
highlights: Designed a layered offline-first data architecture — SQLite on native, IndexedDB in-browser, WatermelonDB as the unified sync layer, MMKV/localStorage for caching — enabling full offline use with no server dependency.
Implemented lazy loading across the data layer to keep the app fast and consistent across native and web platforms.
